date_rules.plan_period: start_date and end_date are ISO YYYY-MM-DD; end_date must be on or after start_date
date_rules.task_overdue: A non-deleted task is overdue when status is not done, due_date is not null, and due_date is before today's date in Asia/Seoul
date_rules.work_log: started_at and ended_at are timestamptz; ended_at must be on or after started_at; actual_minutes is stored independently from estimated_minutes
date_rules.review_difference: time_difference_minutes = actual_minutes - estimated_minutes; absent sums are zero

plan_revisions.rule: A BEFORE UPDATE trigger on plans stores the previous plan values here so edits never erase the prior version.

tasks.delete_rule: User deletion is soft deletion via deleted_at; review aggregates count only deleted_at IS NULL.
tasks.sort_rule: due_date ascending (null last), priority high-medium-low, created_at ascending, id ascending

work_logs.rule: Execution records never overwrite plan or task estimates.

completion_events.rule: Completion is idempotent: one task has at most one completion event and an idempotency key can be used only once.

definitions.total_tasks: Count of non-deleted tasks belonging to the plan
definitions.completed_tasks: Count of those tasks whose current status is done
definitions.delayed_tasks: Count of non-completed tasks whose due_date is before today in Asia/Seoul
definitions.blocked_tasks: Count of tasks with at least one work log whose blocker_reason is non-empty
definitions.estimated_minutes: Sum of estimated_minutes across non-deleted tasks
definitions.actual_minutes: Sum of actual_minutes across all work logs for non-deleted tasks

server_boundary.database: RLS enabled; browser receives no secret key
